value.answer: Call 911 now - breathing this hard with the ribs pulling in and lips looking dusky means she is not getting enough oxygen and needs emergency help right away.
value.triage: Do not wait or drive yourself if you can call an ambulance - call 911 immediately. If for some reason you cannot reach 911, get to the nearest ER right now. Health811 (811) is for non-urgent advice only - this is not that, this is 911.
